children: Shares of Lam Research rose after the company's board approved a $25 billion share repurchase authorization.
Shares were up 10% to $204.12 as of midday Friday. The stock has gained 19% this year.
The new buyback authorization has no termination date, the company said.

"The share repurchase authorization announced today reinforces our capital allocation plan and commitment to return significant value to stockholders through dividends and share repurchases," Chief Financial Officer Doug Bettinger said. "Our strong positioning at key technology inflections and robust cash generation give us confidence in our ability to deliver on our capital return objectives over time."
